title: Let the browser check the email and URL format
goal: Select email and url controls for contact information and work address.
summary: The submission form requires an email address and a complete website address. Control types allow the browser to first check for common formats and adapt to mobile device keyboards.
tasks: Set the type of #email to email and the type of #work to url.
retains existing tags, name and required. Try entering the email address missing @ and the URL of the work missing the agreement.

example.code:
<label for="site">personal website</label>
<input id="site" type="url" name="site" required>
example.note: url type checks whether the input is a valid absolute URL. required is responsible for determining whether to leave it blank.

hint: Add the type attribute to each input. The two controls should use different types.
